items.title: Special projects
items.summary: Impactful scientific work requires working on the right problems—problems which are not just interesting, but whose solutions matter.
items.summaryZh: 文章讨论了科研项目选择的重要性，强调应关注具有实际影响力的科学问题，而非仅仅追求有趣的研究。

aiReview.reasonZh: 内容过于宏观且缺乏具体技术细节，属于机构愿景描述。
